Andhra CM Fulfills Poll Promise for Hajj Pilgrims

Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu has fulfilled a pre-election promise related to Hajj pilgrims. A panel chief confirmed that approximately 2,000 pilgrims from Andhra Pradesh have safely returned after performing the Hajj pilgrimage. This action aligns with the Chief Minister's electoral commitments.
